research.mtlb.mtlb_blueprint.desc: Integrated MT-LB part holding the hull, engine bay and both running gear assemblies.
research.mtlb.pkt_turret_blueprint.desc: A PKT machine gun turret that fits any vehicle with a matching ring mount; the ring, gun and loader are one part.
description.mtlb.blueprint.mtlb: Soviet light tracked armoured carrier introduced in 1964. Two crew plus about ten infantry, or 2 t of cargo, and it can tow 6.5 t of artillery. Armour is only 7-14 mm, enough for small arms and shell splinters, and the vehicle swims by turning its tracks. Cheap, reliable and highly mobile off-road, it served as both prime mover and APC and spawned a very large family of variants.
description.mtlb.blueprint.mtlb_pkt: An MT-LB fitted with a PKT machine gun turret at the right front of the hull. The 7.62 mm PKT traverses a full 360 degrees by hand and elevates from -5 to +30 degrees, with 2,500 rounds for suppressing infantry and light targets. Troop carrying and towing capacity are retained, making this one of the most common frontline MT-LB configurations.
